tooltips.sourceId: Routable channel-specific identifier (E.164 phone for WhatsApp/SMS, page-scoped user id for Instagram/Facebook, chat id for Telegram, lowercased email for Email). Manually entered social identities may temporarily hold the handle here until the first inbound message resolves the scoped id.
tooltips.handle: Human-readable username/handle (e.g. Instagram username, @-stripped, lowercased). Not routable — kept alongside the scoped-id Source ID so both observations merge into one identity.
tooltips.whatsappLid: WhatsApp privacy identifier (LID) observed for this WhatsApp identity. Kept alongside the phone number so LID-keyed chats resolve to the same identity.
tooltips.label: Optional human-readable label (e.g. Instagram username)
tooltips.chatwootAccount: Originating Chatwoot account where this identity was first observed
